about:
9th Street Clothing Co operates a retail clothing store in Yankton, South Dakota. The business maintains a storefront at 410 East 2nd Street, where it is open Monday through Friday from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Saturday from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed on the company’s website.

The store carries a curated selection of men’s and women’s apparel, footwear, and accessories. Brands stocked include Dex, Yellowbox, and Room 34 by Dex, with product categories spanning tops, bottoms, sweaters, denim, dresses, shoes, boots, and accessories. Inventory is sold through both the physical location and the company’s e-commerce site, which offers free standard shipping on orders exceeding $99. The site also features a VIP text-messaging program for promotional updates.

The company serves individual consumers rather than industrial or wholesale buyers. Customer feedback displayed on the homepage shows a 4.91-star average across 334 verified reviews, indicating a strong local and online following. No specific industry verticals or B2B customer types are identified.

The company has not published a mission statement or origin story on its homepage; a “Read Our Story” link is present but the corresponding content was not provided in the source material.
